title: Add StoryStudio to writing
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [StoryStudio](https://eiigen.github.io/storystudio-app) to writing
- AI StoryStudio — A web-based storybook generator powered by Pollinations.ai. Enter any theme and get a fully illustrated multi-page story with AI-generated text, images, and optional audio narration. 

Fixes #12650

gist.headline: Story seeds, illustrated
gist.blurb: StoryStudio joined the writing garden. Give it a theme and it grows a multi-page illustrated storybook, with optional narration for anyone who prefers their plotlines spoken aloud.
gist.summary: Added StoryStudio to the writing apps directory, a Pollinations-powered web app that turns a theme into a fully illustrated multi-page story with AI text, images, and optional audio narration.
gist.impact: People looking for a storybook generator can now discover StoryStudio directly through Pollinations' writing app listings.
gist.visual_concept: Depict StoryStudio as a magical open storybook growing from a cozy garden desk: each page contains a tiny illustrated scene, while soft audio-note sprites float above it. Polli wears a small writer's beret and gently places a glowing seed labeled "THEME" into the book; code-plants and flowers frame the scene to show that the story is generated with Pollinations.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny writer's beret, planting a glowing "THEME" seed into an open multi-page storybook that blooms with tiny illustrated landscapes and floating musical notes for narration. A retro terminal and code-plants sit among warm cream flowers, with lime green (#ecf874) prominently glowing across the pages; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but beautiful.
